questions.title: Spot the Non Arithmetic Operator
questions.description: Java arithmetic operators are +, -, *, / and %. One of the options below belongs to a different operator family. Which of the following is NOT an arithmetic operator in Java?

questions.title: Integer Division and Remainder
questions.description: Both operands are int, so / performs integer division and % gives the remainder. What are the values of the expressions 17 / 5 and 17 % 5 in Java?

questions.title: Comparing int With double
questions.description: When one operand of == is int and the other is double, the int is promoted to double before the comparison. What does the expression 7 == 7.0 evaluate to in Java?

questions.title: When Logical AND Is True
questions.description: The logical AND operator combines two boolean operands. The && operator returns true only when which condition holds?
questions.Option1: At least one operand is true

questions.title: Bitwise AND Result
questions.description: 6 in binary is 110 and 3 is 011; the & operator combines the numbers bit by bit. What is the value of the expression 6 & 3?

questions.title: Compound Modulo Assignment
questions.description: Java offers a compound assignment form for every binary arithmetic operator. Which single statement is equivalent to x = x % 5;?

questions.title: Postfix Increment Output
Ternary Operator Symbols
questions.description: It needs exactly two symbols and three operands. Which pair of symbols forms the conditional (ternary) operator in Java?

questions.title: Casting double To int
questions.description: A cast from double to int never rounds; it truncates toward zero. What is the value of the expression (int) 7.9 in Java?

questions.title: Purpose of instanceof
questions.description: It is a comparison operator that works on object references, not on primitives. The instanceof operator in Java is used to do what?
questions.Option1: Check whether an object is an instance of a given type
questions.Option2: Compare two primitive values for equality
questions.Option3: Create a new object of a class
questions.Option4: Convert one primitive type into another
